run_multi_image_vision_inference: run offline inference with multi-image input on vision language models using vLLM
run_generate_with_vlm: run generate method on a vision language model with multiple images and a question prompt
run_chat_with_vlm: run chat method on a vision language model with multiple images using the LLM chat API
load_model_request_data: load model-specific engine args, prompt template, and image data for a supported vision language model
parse_cli_args_for_vlm: parse command line arguments to select model type, inference method, seed, and number of images
